subject: Request: Exec review for exceptional Hosted API rate (22% off) — Pulselytics
messages:
From: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@pulselytics.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@pulselytics.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry and possible pilot

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo this week. The team at Pulselytics is excited about Redwood's performance characteristics for our streaming ingestion patterns. We ran a quick internal model and expect ~1.2B tokens/month in steady state with a 6–9 month ramp.

Two asks from procurement before we move to PO:
- Can you provide a 12-month committed rate for Hosted API that reflects volume (we're exploring a committed plan).
- We're requesting a one-time commercial concession: a 22% unit-rate discount for the first 6 months to help bridge our ramp risk. This is higher than standard published tiers, but if accepted we would commit to a 12-month reserved billing schedule and include a short case study.

I've attached our usage forecast for context. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

—Alex
Alex Cheng
Head of Platform, Pulselytics
alex.cheng@pulselytics.ai
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: usage-forecast-pulselytics.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry and possible pilot

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask and the forecast — this is helpful. I'm attaching an updated quote (redwood-hosted-quote-v2.pdf) that models the 12-month committed cadence and usage tiers.

Short version: a 22% concession on Hosted API unit rates is outside my desk-level discount authority; we typically cap at 15% for renewals/commitment promos. Given the size and potential case study, I want to escalate to get an exec-level exception decision.

Proposed internal ask: executive approval for a 22% upfront concession on unit pricing for months 1–6, with a standard ramp clause and the 12-month minimum commit. If approved, we'll attach a short performance SLA addendum and lock in the DocuSign PO.

Can I get Marissa and Rishi looped in to expedite? If we can move quickly, Pulselytics wants to sign and start pilot infra in June.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-hosted-quote-v2.pdf (pdf)

Looping you both for an expedited exec review. Pulselytics is asking for a 22% concession on Hosted API unit rates for months 1–6 in a 12-month committed plan. Key points:

Ben / Rishi —

Thanks for the context and the attachment. Two quick thoughts before I put this to Lauren for final sign-off:
1) Can we tighten the concession window to 4 months instead of 6 (reduces revenue drag) and require a minimum $350k prepayment toward the 12-month commitment? That gives us more protection if they under-deliver.
2) Add a clause: if Pulselytics exceeds forecasted tokens by >20% in any single month during months 1–4, we re-evaluate the concession and reserve the right to apply the standard committed rate retroactively for that month.

If Rishi is comfortable operationally with the SLA/overage controls, I suggest we send a conditional approval note to Lauren for exec approval. If Lauren signs off we can present back to Alex with the revised terms.

—Marissa

Subject: Exec approval: conditional concession granted (22% -> 4-month window)

Team —

After reviewing the commercials and the ramp assumptions, I approve an executive exception for Pulselytics with the following firm conditions: 
1) Concession: 22% off unit Hosted API rate applied for months 1–4 only.
2) Financials: Pulselytics must provide a minimum prepayment of $350,000 within 10 business days of contract signature.
3) Telemetry & controls: monthly shared telemetry reports; automatic reversion to standard committed rates if actual tokens exceed forecast +20% in any month. Retroactive billing adjustment permitted in that event.
4) Documentation: revised SOW & SLA addendum, and a DocuSign PO to be provided before we enable production keys.
5) Case study: Pulselytics agrees to a joint case study to be published within 6 months of production go-live; marketing to coordinate.

Marissa/Rishi — please draft the conditional concession letter and updated DocuSign packet. Ben — you can present the revised terms to Alex ASAP once the paperwork is ready.

Lauren Bishop | VP, Revenue Operations
